name: Northcourt Meridian 14
description: The Northcourt Meridian 14 is a control-first paddle built around a basalt-fiber face, a material that damps vibration more than carbon or fiberglass and suits players recovering from tennis elbow. A 14 mm polypropylene honeycomb core keeps the feel soft at the kitchen line, and the hybrid shape balances reach with a forgiving sweet spot.
care_instructions: Wipe the basalt face with a damp cloth after play and let it air dry. Avoid solvents, and store the paddle in a cover away from direct heat.
